item.title: Adani Power profit surges on high power demand, tariffs, beats street estimates
item.description: Adani Power’s September-quarter profit more than doubled as higher electricity demand and stronger tariffs boosted both sales volumes and earnings per unit. The company comfortably beat Street estimates, aided by rising power prices, better plant utilisation and improving profitability.

item.title: Tata Motors returns to profit with ₹1,254 crore in Q2 earnings as CV sales rise 42%

item.title: From layoff to ₹1.5 crore UAE offer: How reskilling helped a tech professional rebuild his career and boost earnings
item.description: A Reddit user has shared how an early layoff, a move into big data and several job switches took his reported annual compensation from ₹2.9 lakh to a UAE opportunity worth around ₹1.5 crore. His account highlights the role of reskilling, workplace mobility and timing in career progression.

item.title: CM Nayab Saini says Haryana power employees' strike being called off: ‘There will be no privatisation of any kind’
item.description: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini said electricity employees has called off their three-day strike and would return to work after the government invoked Section 108 of the Electricity Act to ask HERC to review its approval for private power distribution in Gurugram and Nuh.

item.title: Haryana power employees’ strike called off: What is Section 108 of Electricity Act invoked by CM Nayab Saini? Explained
item.description: Haryana used Section 108 of the Electricity Act to challenge HERC’s approval for a private power distributor in Gurugram and Nuh, a key demand of striking workers. CM Nayab Saini said the government had assured employees of its support, following which they agreed to return to work immediately.
